name: Fireworks
description: Rockets climb over an ASCII city skyline and burst into peonies, rings, willows, crossettes, hearts and chrysanthemums, lighting up the sky and the windows below. Sparks start white-hot and cool to colour, and every so often a finale salvo fills the sky.
author: Luci Evol - www.evoldigitalproductions.com
